method: binary ecological classification compiled in dataset
note: January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. conditions: adult primary activity period; binary diurnal/non-diurnal classification
method: binary ecological classification compiled in dataset
note: January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original ecology source: Kwet & Lignau (2010). Non-diurnal combines arrhythmic, cathemeral, crepuscular and nocturnal species; it must not be interpreted as nocturnal. No activity assigned to NA rows.

source.authors: Thomas KN, Rich C, Quock R, Streicher JW, Gower DJ, Schott RK, Fujita MK, Bell RC
source.title: Diversity and evolution of amphibian pupil shapes [Data set]

conditions: partially or fully constricted adult pupil; illumination uncontrolled
method: dataset classification from photographs or literature descriptions
note: new trait: pupil shape/orientation is not represented by another listed trait. January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original pupil source: AmphibiaWeb (2021) photos. Image/description: https://calphotos.berkeley.edu/cgi/img_query?enlarge=1111+1111+1111+1395. Combined almond/slit category retained; does not resolve oval versus slit at maximum constriction.

method: dataset classification from photographs or literature descriptions
note: new trait: pupil shape/orientation is not represented by another listed trait. January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original pupil source: AmphibiaWeb (2021) photos. Image/description: https://calphotos.berkeley.edu/cgi/img_query?enlarge=0000+0000+0219+0617. Combined almond/slit category retained; does not resolve oval versus slit at maximum constriction.

method: dataset classification from photographs or literature descriptions
note: new trait: pupil shape/orientation is not represented by another listed trait. January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original pupil source: AmphibiaWeb (2021) photos. Image/description: https://calphotos.berkeley.edu/cgi/img_query?enlarge=1111+1111+1111+1393. Combined almond/slit category retained; does not resolve oval versus slit at maximum constriction.

conditions: adult primary activity period; binary diurnal/non-diurnal classification
method: binary ecological classification compiled in dataset
note: January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original ecology source: Glaw & Vences (2007). Non-diurnal combines arrhythmic, cathemeral, crepuscular and nocturnal species; it must not be interpreted as nocturnal. No activity assigned to NA rows.

conditions: partially or fully constricted adult pupil; illumination uncontrolled
method: dataset classification from photographs or literature descriptions
note: new trait: pupil shape/orientation is not represented by another listed trait. January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original pupil source: AmphibiaWeb (2021) photos. Image/description: https://calphotos.berkeley.edu/cgi/img_query?enlarge=1111+1111+1111+5850. Combined almond/slit category retained; does not resolve oval versus slit at maximum constriction.

conditions: partially or fully constricted adult pupil; illumination uncontrolled
method: dataset classification from photographs or literature descriptions
note: new trait: pupil shape/orientation is not represented by another listed trait. January 2022 NHM dataset associated with the preprint, 1293 species; published article has 1294 and revised categories. Raw dataset observation/classification, not a phylogenetic imputation. Conservatively grade g because this is a photographic/literature compilation; original cited material was not independently opened. Original pupil source: AmphibiaWeb (2021) photos. Image/description: https://calphotos.berkeley.edu/cgi/img_query?enlarge=0000+0000+0313+2293. Combined almond/slit category retained; does not resolve oval versus slit at maximum constriction.
